name: vanille
description: bootstrap commands for the vanille service stack.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix frontmatter ci && npm --prefix frontpage ci && npm --prefix backend ci && uv sync --directory db --frozen
scripts.dev:db: cd db && uv run --frozen --env-file ../.env uvicorn vanille_db.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 9003 --reload
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontmatter run build && npm --prefix frontpage run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.check: npm --prefix frontmatter run typecheck && npm --prefix frontmatter run lint && npm --prefix frontpage run typecheck && npm --prefix frontpage run lint && npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run lint && uv run --directory db --frozen ruff check src && uv run --directory db --frozen python -m compileall -q src
